subject.title: feat(gateway): add context engine control API

question: Should OpenClaw expose context-engine status, doctor, and rotate through a core Gateway/plugin control API after the session-targeting blocker is fixed?
rationale: The session canonicalization bug is mechanical, but the permanent HTTP route, operator scopes, and optional ContextEngine control hooks are new compatibility-sensitive API surface.

options.title: Approve after scoping fix
options.body: Keep the proposed API direction, but require canonical session targeting, focused regression tests, docs/export follow-through, and a clean merge result before landing.

options.title: Narrow to read-only control
options.body: Land only capabilities/status/doctor first and defer admin rotate until maintainers are ready to own that operator action.

options.title: Defer the core API
options.body: Pause or close the PR and keep context-engine maintenance control on plugin/private surfaces until a broader Gateway control contract is designed.

recommendation.title: Approve after scoping fix
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed API direction, but require canonical session targeting, focused regression tests, docs/export follow-through, and a clean merge result before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses Gateway session authorization, security-sensitive control, and recent session canonicalization ownership.
